A standard training augmentation recipe in one node.

The preset compiles into the image transform nodes it stands for, so it behaves exactly as wiring them by hand: flip = Horizontal Flip (0.5); cifar = Random Crop of the image size with padding 4, then Horizontal Flip (0.5); cifar_cutout = cifar, then Advanced Augment cutout 16 on every image (DeVries & Taylor 2017); randaugment = Horizontal Flip (0.5), then RandAugment (2 ops, magnitude 9) on every image. Training images only; validation and test pass through. Normalize stays its own node after the preset.

## Where it runs

| Where | Runs |
| --- | --- |
| Data pipeline (run the graph, **Run step**, previews) | No: Augmentation Preset is a training image transform: it compiles into image transform ops the image batcher runs on the ArrayFire device between Resize and Normalize; PipelineExecutor image transforms are not implemented |
| Training (the compiled model) | Yes, as a preprocessing step |

The node runs on the device chosen for the run (CPU or a GPU); a node does not fix a device.

## Usage

```text
Resize 32 -> Augmentation Preset (cifar) -> Normalize -> Conv2D
```

```text
flip = Horizontal Flip. cifar = Random Crop (image size, padding 4) + Horizontal Flip. cifar_cutout = cifar + cutout 16. randaugment = Horizontal Flip + RandAugment (2, 9). Training only; Normalize stays its own node.
```

## Tips

- cifar suits small images (32 x 32); randaugment suits larger photos.
- Replace the preset with the single nodes to tune any step.
